subject.title: feat(config): add compaction.thinkingLevel to override thinking level during compaction

question: Should OpenClaw add `agents.defaults.compaction.thinkingLevel` as a supported public config key for compaction-only reasoning control?
rationale: The patch adds a new user-facing config surface, and repository policy treats config/default additions as high-bar product decisions even when the implementation is otherwise bounded.

options.title: Accept after complete wiring and docs
options.body: Approve the key only after the PR passes the resolved compaction thinking level through all local compaction paths and documents scope, values, and Codex-native behavior.

options.title: Decline the new config key
options.body: Keep compaction tied to the session/default thinking level and avoid growing the public config surface for this behavior.

options.title: Narrow to an existing setting
options.body: Ask for a design that reuses an existing thinking/default surface if maintainers want one source of truth instead of a new compaction-specific key.

recommendation.title: Accept after complete wiring and docs
recommendation.body: Approve the key only after the PR passes the resolved compaction thinking level through all local compaction paths and documents scope, values, and Codex-native behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to this PR and is the clearest current routing point for accepting or declining the new config surface.
